Home.heroBody: Explore the map and discover historical photographs from across Morocco. Upload your own vintage images and help preserve the country's collective memory.

Auth.confirmEmailNotice: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

Profile.title: My contributions
Profile.signedOutPrompt: You need to be signed in to see your profile and contributions.
Profile.displayNameHelp: Shown as the credit on photos you contribute (e.g. “Archives du Maroc”). Your email stays private. Leave blank to stay anonymous.
Profile.emptySubmissions: You haven’t submitted any photographs yet. Upload your first historical photo to start building the archive.
Profile.feedbackBody: Curator and community feedback on your submissions will appear here once the collaborative review process picks up your contributions. Keep documenting — accurate sources and context help your photos get verified faster.

Upload.title: Upload a photo
Upload.introGuest: You're not signed in — sign in to attribute this upload to your account, or continue as a guest.
Upload.introUser: Add an old photograph, let AI suggest the details, review, and publish.
Upload.rateLimited: You're going too fast. Please wait a moment before analyzing another image.
Upload.suspensionBody: You've submitted several images that fall outside MAPMA's scope. Continuing to upload unrelated content means you risk having your profile put on hold, pending administrator approval. MAPMA archives only pre-2000 Moroccan heritage photographs.
Upload.outOfScopeDefault: This image isn't a pre-2000 Moroccan heritage photograph, so it can't be published.
Upload.inScope: This image fits MAPMA's scope. Review the details below and publish.
Upload.lowConfidence: — low confidence. The AI is unsure, so please verify and correct the title, location, and year below with your own knowledge rather than trusting these suggestions.
Upload.locationHint: Click or drag the pin to set the spot, or type exact coordinates below.
Upload.errOutOfScope: This image is outside MAPMA's scope (Morocco, pre-2000 heritage only) and can't be published.
Upload.errLocation: Set the location on the map.
Upload.errYear: A known year before 2000 is required — MAPMA only archives pre-2000 material.
